html: † יְהוֹעַדָּה n.pr.m. (meaning dub.; Thes י׳ hath adorned (as Heb. עדה Hiph.; vb. of Pa. form); MV י׳ is equipment, cf. Arabic عُدَّةٌ; possibly י׳ hath carried off spoil, or hath deposed (𝔗 עדא Pe Pa Aph; cf. Haph. Dn 2:21); or perhaps י׳ hath numbered Arabic عَدَّ )—a descendant of Saul 1 Ch 8:36(×2) (𝔊 Ἰαδα, A Ἰωιαδα, 𝔊L Ἰωδα) = יַעְרָה 9:42(×2) (for יֹעַדָּה? cf. Be; 𝔊 Ἰαδα, 𝔊L Ἰωδα).
